authors: Maike Willke, Nils-Eric Rahm, Stephan Kabelac
name: luh-coupled-transport-mechanisms-in-a-pem-based-thermoelectric-energy-converter
notes:
This set provides experimental data and code for the following paper: Willke, M., Rahm, N.-E., Kabelac, S.: Experimental Investigation of Coupled Transport Mechanisms in a PEM Based Thermoelectric Energy Converter.

The dataset includes the raw data for the open circuit measurements (Fig. 7, 8 and 9) and the raw data for the electrochemical impedance measurements for the determination of the phenomenological coefficient Lpp (Fig. 10).
The python code was used to analyse the raw data of the EIS measurements to determine the phenomonological coefficient Lpp.

Acknowledgements: This research project was funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) (Project-ID  449554201).
